description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LDAPConfigAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It defines test cases for methods such as getOne, update, and also includes setup for LDAP configurations and related test data.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LDAPConfigAPI functionalities, including retrieving, updating, and deleting LDAP configurations in the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single LDAP configuration using the LDAPConfigAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for testGetOne method, loading data from LDAPConfigTestCases.yaml with the 'GetOne' key.

methods.name: saveLDAPConfigPreHook
methods.description: Sets up and persists a sample LDAP configuration before tests, used as a fixture for LDAP-related tests.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the updating of LDAP configuration via LDAPConfigAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testUpdate method, loading data from LDAPConfigTestCases.yaml with the 'Update' key.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation in LDAPConfigAPI is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the validation rule for deletion is not implemented and throws the expected exception.
